_comment: Lower-sugar swaps. 'savory' applies to mains, sides, soups and breakfasts; 'sweet' to desserts and drinks.

savory.jaggery: a little caramelised onion (or leave the jaggery out)
savory.sugar: leave it out; tomato and onion carry the sweetness

sweet.jaggery: half the jaggery, topped up to taste with a stevia or monk-fruit sweetener
sweet.sugar: half the sugar, topped up to taste with a stevia or monk-fruit sweetener

tips.savory: Gentle sweetness can come from caramelised onion or roasted pumpkin.
tips.sweet: Add a pinch of cinnamon and extra cardamom: warm spices taste sweet. Rice, milk and coconut still carry carbs, so keep portions small.
